Source   Edit  

Structured logger — nullclaw Observer pattern, Nim flavour.

Usage: let log = newLogger("agent.memory") log.info("loaded 42 memories") let child = log.child("retrieval")

Tests pass a custom sink proc to capture output. In production the default sink writes to stderr.
